name: 5T OTA gm/VCA cell for Tiny Tapeout FPAA

mentions.name: 5T OTA gm/VCA cell for Tiny Tapeout FPAA
mentions.description: A five-transistor OTA (operational transconductance amplifier) designed as a gm/VCA cell primitive for a Tiny Tapeout FPAA, meant to serve as a building block for useful analog circuits such as summers and filters. Specs and area are not the current focus.
mentions.source_excerpt:
5T OTA to use as a gm/VCA cell primitive for my Tiny Tapeout FPAA.

Specs/area are not the focus currently. I just want to build a few useful blocks with it (e.g. analog summer, filter, ...).
